purpose: A right-aligned row of buttons for a card, in Mac order, with the positive action (Done, Save, Add, Make…) as the rightmost child and Cancel, Clear, Remove or Discard to its left.
namedChanges: The header comment is reworded; no code change.

library.title: Button row (Mac order)
library.note: Only lays out buttons; for one button look take button. For the remove control take remove-control.
